name: Boise 2019

venue.name: Red Lion Hotel Boise Downtowner
venue.details: Bitterroot/Sawtooth Ballroom on the first floor near the lobby

information:
Please make sure you know all of the WCA regulations.

If you haven't attended a competition before or even would just like a refresher on how they work, please show up for the competitor tutorial at 9am.

We would also recommend that you watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww).

If you are in the Boise area, please consider joining the [Boise Speedcubing Club](https://www.facebook.com/boisespeedcubing/) to meet other members of the community and influence future competitions!
